A short guide to Izhevsk: coffee, food, walks, places for children, and shopping. Open a section from the bottom tabs or the side menu, then tap a card for details.
Author: Anatoly Prozorov.
Coffee by the embankment
Take a drink and walk along the pond.
The Dudin embankment is an easy place for coffee on the go. The air from the water and the view of the pond make a short break pleasant.
Coffee in the Summer Garden
A bench in the historic park by the pond.
Gorky Summer Garden sits by the pond. It is an easy place to combine a drink with a walk under the trees on a warm day.
A cup on Central Square
A short stop by the esplanade and Izhik.
Central Square is a handy stop in the middle of the city. After coffee you can see the Izhik sculpture and walk down toward the water.
Coffee in Talisman
A warm hall when it is raining or freezing outside.
Talisman mall on Kholmogorova 11 is a place to drink coffee without walking in the cold. It is easy to combine with shopping.
Lunch by the pond
Eat after a walk along the embankment.
The Dudin embankment area is a good place for lunch after a walk. Leave time to go down the stairs to the water afterward.
Dinner in the center
A meal and a quiet walk through the central streets.
Central Izhevsk works well if you want to walk to the square or the Summer Garden after eating.
A family table at Moy Port
Several kitchens in one building.
Moy Port mall at Kirova 146 suits a family: shops and a cinema are nearby, and you can pick the food that fits the mood.
A snack by the zoo
Eat before or after the enclosures.
The Udmurtia Zoo is at Kirova 8. Plan a meal nearby so you do not have to rush between the exhibits.
Dudin Embankment
The main walk along the Izhevsk pond.
A wide embankment with stairs and views of the water. It is especially pleasant in the morning and evening, when the paths are quieter.
Gorky Summer Garden
A historic park by the pond.
Paths, rides, and a Ferris wheel. It is an easy visit with children, with benches close to the water.
Kirov Park
A large park next to the zoo.
There is room for a quiet path and for a family day. The zoo is nearby, so the route is easy to extend.
Friendship of Peoples monument
A tall obelisk by the pond.
The monument marks Udmurtia joining Russia and is one of the city symbols. From here it is natural to continue along the embankment.
Central Square
The esplanade and the Izhik sculpture.
An open space in the city center. Izhik was assembled from keys collected by residents and became a city mascot.
Udmurtia Zoo
Animals and paths that work for a family.
The zoo is at Kirova 8. Allow a couple of hours and wear comfortable shoes. With small children it is better to arrive at opening time.
Udmurtia Circus
A show for when everyone is tired of walking.
The city circus is a weekend option. Check the schedule before you leave, because daytime and evening shows differ.
Kalashnikov Museum
The story of weapons and the city for schoolchildren.
The complex at Borodina 19 suits schoolchildren, with exhibits and a shooting range. Monday is usually closed, so check the hours before you go.
Summer Garden rides
A Ferris wheel and play areas by the pond.
After the rides it is easy to walk out to the water. In summer the lines are longer, so come earlier.
Talisman mall
A large center at Kholmogorova 11.
Shops, food, and a place to wait out bad weather. Useful when you want to do the shopping in one building.
Moy Port mall
A center at Kirova 146.
It has a hypermarket, a cinema, and family entertainment. You can cover both shopping and free time here.
Omega mall
A center at 10 Let Oktyabrya 32.
A place for ordinary shopping in the industrial district when you do not want to go all the way downtown.
Central market
Food and small stalls.
The market is the place for fresh food rather than mall windows. Morning is the easier time, and it helps to bring a bag.
